description: Claude Sonnet 4 is an Anthropic frontier language model designed for general instruction following, reasoning, coding, analysis, and tool-oriented workflows.
DeepSeek V3 0324 is a general-purpose mixture-of-experts language model with strong instruction following, knowledge, reasoning, and coding capabilities.
DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus is a later general-purpose DeepSeek model supporting broad reasoning, coding, knowledge, and agentic instruction tasks.
DeepSeek R1 0528 is a reasoning-focused model optimized for multi-step mathematical, scientific, logical, and coding problem solving.
Gemini 2.5 Flash is a Google model optimized for fast and cost-efficient general reasoning, instruction following, coding, and long-context processing.
Gemini 2.5 Pro is a Google frontier model for advanced reasoning, coding, knowledge-intensive tasks, and long-context understanding.
GPT-5 with medium reasoning effort is an OpenAI frontier model for complex reasoning, coding, knowledge, instruction following, and tool use.
Qwen3-235B-A22B 2507 is a large Alibaba mixture-of-experts model for general instruction following, multilingual knowledge, coding, and reasoning.
Qwen3-235B-A22B Thinking 2507 is the reasoning-oriented variant of Qwen3-235B, emphasizing extended mathematical, logical, scientific, and coding reasoning.
GLM-4.6 is a Zhipu AI general-purpose language model supporting reasoning, coding, multilingual instruction following, and tool-use tasks.
Kimi K2 0905 is a Moonshot AI mixture-of-experts model designed for general instruction following, coding, knowledge, reasoning, and agentic tasks.
Intern-S1 is a science-oriented foundation model emphasizing mathematical and scientific reasoning while retaining general instruction-following capabilities.
